method.size: esbuild --bundle --minify (tree-shaken to primary API), gzipped by node:zlib at its default level
method.timing: process-cold (bench/run.ts): every sample is a fresh node process; index = the constructor call, query = the first answer per probe, batch = all probes once in one process; medians across processes, min kept; no warm-loop sampling anywhere
method.quality: MRR@10 over catalogue.ts's sampled families, weighted by group (typos 0.35, phonetic 0.25, partial words 0.15, query shape 0.15, noise 0.10); junk = share of queries nothing answers that a library answers anyway; ranks are deterministic and measured untimed

corpora.en: English labels of the best-known Wikidata people, places, works, organisations and products — 8.9% of items carry a non-ASCII letter
corpora.native: the same items under their Wikidata native name where one exists — 20% non-ASCII, 10% in a non-Latin script
corpora.emoji: every emojibase-data emoji as label then tags, 1,923 items — scored for quality only
